mapper.sql: SELECT id FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 AND (visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR (visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND owner_user_id = #{userId}))

WITH visible_questions AS (), library AS ( SELECT create_time FROM user_course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ), answer_facts AS ( SELECT 'PRACTICE' AS source, p.id, p.question_id, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS knowledge_points_json, p.is_correct, p.create_time AS occurred_time FROM practice_record p JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = p.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.create_time >= l.create_time AND p.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'PAPER_LEARNING', a.id, a.question_id, NULL, NULL, a.is_correct, a.create_time FROM exam_learning_session s JOIN exam_learning_answer a ON a.session_id = s.id JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = a.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND a.create_time >= l.create_time AND a.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'EXAM', a.id, a.question_id, NULL, NULL, a.is_correct, COALESCE(a.reviewed_at, a.create_time) FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_answer a ON a.exam_record_id = r.id JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = a.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 0 AND a.create_time >= l.create_time AND a.grading_status IN ('AUTO_GRADED', 'REVIEWED') AND a.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'TUTOR_CHECK', s.id, NULL, s.knowledge_point_id, NULL, s.check_correct, s.check_answered_at FROM tutor_session s CROSS JOIN library l WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.check_answered_at >= l.create_time AND s.check_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.check_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'AI_VARIANT', t.id, t.question_id, NULL, NULL, t.is_correct, t.answered_time FROM ai_variant_training t JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = t.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.answered_time >= l.create_time AND t.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT', q.id, q.question_id, NULL, q.knowledge_points_json, q.is_correct, q.answered_time FROM course_stage_assessment a JOIN course_stage_assessment_question q ON q.assessment_id = a.id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.status = 'COMPLETED' AND q.answered_time >= l.create_time AND q.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(q.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') ), wrong_facts AS ( SELECT w.* FROM wrong_question w JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = w.question_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.mastery_level != 2 ), due_facts AS ( SELECT s.* FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.next_review_date <= #{today} AND q.id IN (${automaticallyGradableQuestionIds}) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_facts) AS answered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_facts WHERE is_correct = 1) AS correct_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_facts) AS unresolved_wrong_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM due_facts) AS due_review_count, (SELECT MAX(occurred_time) FROM ( SELECT occurred_time FROM answer_facts UNION ALL SELECT e.occurred_time FROM course_learning_event e CROSS JOIN library l WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.occurred_time >= l.create_time ) activity) AS last_learning_time
mapper.sql: , current_points AS ( SELECT id, name, sort_order FROM knowledge_point WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 ), question_points AS ( SELECT rel.question_id, kp.id FROM question_knowledge_point rel JOIN current_points kp ON kp.id = rel.knowledge_point_id ), attributed_answers AS ( SELECT f.source, f.id, p.id AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS snapshot_name, f.is_correct, f.occurred_time FROM answer_facts f LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = f.question_id WHERE f.source NOT IN ('TUTOR_CHECK', 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT') UNION ALL SELECT source, id, knowledge_point_id, NULL, is_correct, occurred_time FROM answer_facts WHERE source = 'TUTOR_CHECK' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT f.source, f.id, IF(j.id > 0, j.id, NULL), j.name, f.is_correct, f.occurred_time FROM answer_facts f LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE( CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(f.knowledge_points_json) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(f.knowledge_points_json) = 'ARRAY' THEN f.knowledge_points_json ELSE '[]' END ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS (id BIGINT PATH '$.id' NULL ON ERROR, name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.name' NULL ON ERROR) ) j ON TRUE WHERE f.source = 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT' ), snapshot_names AS ( SELECT knowledge_point_id, snapshot_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY knowledge_point_id ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC, snapshot_name DESC) AS name_order FROM attributed_answers WHERE snapshot_name IS NOT NULL ), answer_counts AS ( SELECT knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT source, id) AS answered_count, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_correct = 1, source, NULL), IF(is_correct = 1, id, NULL)) AS correct_count FROM attributed_answers GROUP BY knowledge_point_id ), wrong_counts AS ( SELECT p.id AS knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT w.question_id) AS unresolved_wrong_count FROM wrong_facts w LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = w.question_id GROUP BY p.id ), due_counts AS ( SELECT p.id AS knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.question_id) AS due_review_count FROM due_facts d LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = d.question_id GROUP BY p.id ), point_ids AS ( SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM answer_counts UNION SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM wrong_counts UNION SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM due_counts )
mapper.select: SELECT p.knowledge_point_id, CASE WHEN p.knowledge_point_id IS NULL THEN '未关联知识点' ELSE COALESCE(k.name, n.snapshot_name, CONCAT('知识点 #', p.knowledge_point_id)) END AS knowledge_point_name, k.id IS NOT NULL AS available, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tutor_content t WHERE t.knowledge_point_id = k.id AND t.review_status = 'REVIEWED') AS tutor_available, COALESCE(a.answered_count, 0) AS answered_count, COALESCE(a.correct_count, 0) AS correct_count, COALESCE(w.unresolved_wrong_count, 0) AS unresolved_wrong_count, COALESCE(d.due_review_count, 0) AS due_review_count FROM point_ids p LEFT JOIN current_points k ON k.id = p.knowledge_point_id LEFT JOIN snapshot_names n ON n.knowledge_point_id = p.knowledge_point_id AND n.name_order = 1 LEFT JOIN answer_counts a ON a.knowledge_point_id <=> p.knowledge_point_id LEFT JOIN wrong_counts w ON w.knowledge_point_id <=> p.knowledge_point_id LEFT JOIN due_counts d ON d.knowledge_point_id <=> p.knowledge_point_id ORDER BY k.id IS NULL, k.sort_order, p.knowledge_point_id IS NULL, p.knowledge_point_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.question_id FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN () q ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.next_review_date <= #{today} AND q.id IN (${automaticallyGradableQuestionIds}) ORDER BY s.next_review_date, s.id LIMIT 1
SELECT w.question_id FROM wrong_question w JOIN () q ON q.id = w.question_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.mastery_level != 2 ORDER BY w.wrong_count DESC, w.id LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE siblings AS ( SELECT k.id, k.parent_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.parent_id ORDER BY k.sort_order, k.id) AS position FROM knowledge_point k WHERE k.course_id = #{courseId} AND k.deleted = 0 ), course_tree AS ( SELECT id, CAST(LPAD(position, 10, '0') AS CHAR(1024)) AS path FROM siblings WHERE parent_id = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id, CONCAT(parent.path, '.', LPAD(child.position, 10, '0')) FROM siblings child JOIN course_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id ) SELECT t.knowledge_point_id, t.title, CASE WHEN MAX(s.check_correct) = 1 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COUNT(s.id) > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END AS status, MAX(s.create_time) AS last_session_time FROM course_tree tree JOIN knowledge_point k ON k.id = tree.id JOIN tutor_content t ON t.knowledge_point_id = k.id AND t.review_status = 'REVIEWED' LEFT JOIN tutor_session s ON s.tutor_content_id = t.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} WHERE k.course_id = #{courseId} AND k.deleted = 0 AND k.content_review_status = 'REVIEWED' GROUP BY k.id, tree.path, t.id, t.knowledge_point_id, t.title ORDER BY tree.path, t.id
mapper.sql: SELECT course_id, create_time FROM user_course WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND course_id IN #{id}

SELECT l.course_id, p.id, p.is_correct, p.create_time occurred_time FROM practice_record p JOIN question q ON q.id=p.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.create_time>=l.create_time AND p.is_correct IN (0,1) AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, a.id, a.is_correct, a.create_time FROM exam_learning_session s JOIN exam_learning_answer a ON a.session_id=s.id JOIN question q ON q.id=a.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND a.create_time>=l.create_time AND a.is_correct IN (0,1) AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, a.id, a.is_correct, COALESCE(a.reviewed_at,a.create_time) FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_answer a ON a.exam_record_id=r.id JOIN question q ON q.id=a.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status!=0 AND a.create_time>=l.create_time AND a.grading_status IN ('AUTO_GRADED','REVIEWED') AND a.is_correct IN (0,1) AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, s.id, s.check_correct, s.check_answered_at FROM tutor_session s JOIN library l ON l.course_id=s.course_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.check_answered_at>=l.create_time AND s.check_correct IN (0,1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.check_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, t.id, t.is_correct, t.answered_time FROM ai_variant_training t JOIN question q ON q.id=t.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.status='COMPLETED' AND t.answered_time>=l.create_time AND t.is_correct IN (0,1) AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, q.id, q.is_correct, q.answered_time FROM course_stage_assessment a JOIN course_stage_assessment_question q ON q.assessment_id=a.id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=a.course_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.status='COMPLETED' AND q.answered_time>=l.create_time AND q.is_correct IN (0,1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(q.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]')
mapper.select: WITH library AS (), facts AS (), fact_stats AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) answered_count, COALESCE(SUM(is_correct=1),0) correct_count FROM facts GROUP BY course_id), activity AS ( SELECT course_id, occurred_time FROM facts UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, e.occurred_time FROM course_learning_event e JOIN library l ON l.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.occurred_time>=l.create_time ), wrong AS (SELECT q.course_id, COUNT(*) count_value FROM wrong_question w JOIN question q ON q.id=w.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE w.user_id=#{userId} AND w.deleted=0 AND w.mastery_level!=2 AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) GROUP BY q.course_id), due AS (SELECT q.course_id, COUNT(*) count_value FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN question q ON q.id=s.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.next_review_date<=#{today} AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND q.id IN (${automaticallyGradableQuestionIds}) GROUP BY q.course_id), activity_stats AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(occurred_time) last_learning_time FROM activity GROUP BY course_id) SELECT l.course_id, COALESCE(f.answered_count,0) answered_count, COALESCE(f.correct_count,0) correct_count, COALESCE(d.count_value,0) due_review_count, COALESCE(w.count_value,0) unresolved_wrong_count, a.last_learning_time FROM library l LEFT JOIN fact_stats f ON f.course_id=l.course_id LEFT JOIN activity_stats a ON a.course_id=l.course_id LEFT JOIN wrong w ON w.course_id=l.course_id LEFT JOIN due d ON d.course_id=l.course_id

WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.course_id, s.question_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY q.course_id ORDER BY s.next_review_date,s.id) rank_no FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN question q ON q.id=s.question_id JOIN () l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.next_review_date<=#{today} AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND q.id IN (${automaticallyGradableQuestionIds})) SELECT course_id, question_id FROM ranked WHERE rank_no=1

WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.course_id, w.question_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY q.course_id ORDER BY w.wrong_count DESC,w.id) rank_no FROM wrong_question w JOIN question q ON q.id=w.question_id JOIN () l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE w.user_id=#{userId} AND w.deleted=0 AND w.mastery_level!=2 AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId}))) SELECT course_id, question_id FROM ranked WHERE rank_no=1

WITH RECURSIVE siblings AS (SELECT k.id,k.course_id,k.parent_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY k.course_id,k.parent_id ORDER BY k.sort_order,k.id) position FROM knowledge_point k WHERE k.deleted=0 AND k.course_id IN #{id}), tree AS (SELECT id,course_id,CAST(LPAD(position,10,'0') AS CHAR(1024)) path FROM siblings WHERE parent_id=0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id,child.course_id,CONCAT(parent.path,'.',LPAD(child.position,10,'0')) FROM siblings child JOIN tree parent ON child.parent_id=parent.id AND child.course_id=parent.course_id) SELECT tree.course_id, t.knowledge_point_id,t.title,CASE WHEN MAX(s.check_correct)=1 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COUNT(s.id)>0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END status,MAX(s.create_time) last_session_time FROM tree JOIN knowledge_point k ON k.id=tree.id JOIN tutor_content t ON t.knowledge_point_id=k.id AND t.review_status='REVIEWED' LEFT JOIN tutor_session s ON s.tutor_content_id=t.id AND s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.course_id=tree.course_id WHERE k.content_review_status='REVIEWED' GROUP BY tree.course_id,k.id,tree.path,t.id,t.knowledge_point_id,t.title ORDER BY tree.course_id,tree.path,t.id
